
cosmo_daimyo_personal_union_I = {
	copy_from = default
	count = personal_union
	
	# Graphics:
	sprite = GFX_court_union
	diplomacy_overlord_sprite = GFX_diplomacy_leadunions
	diplomacy_subject_sprite = GFX_diplomacy_inunion
	

	
	# Properties:
	has_overlords_ruler = no
	transfer_trade_power = no
	can_release_and_play = no
	overlord_can_be_subject = yes
	can_be_annexed = no
    takes_diplo_slot = no
    gets_help_with_rebels = yes
    separatists_become_subjects = no
    allows_taking_land_without_independence = yes
    can_use_claims = yes
	start_colonial_war = yes
    ##forcelimit_bonus = 1.0
	counts_for_borders = no
	#military_focus = 1.0
	overlord_enforce_peace_attacking = yes
	overlord_protects_external = yes
	has_power_projection = yes
	can_have_subjects_of_other_types = yes
	transfer_subjects_when_made = no	
    uses_tariffs = no
	#liberty_desire_negative_prestige = 0.1
	#can_set_mil_focus = yes	
	#gives_daimyo_bonuses = yes	
	max_government_rank = 0	
	#can_send_missionary_to_subject = yes
	overlord_can_fabricate_for = yes
	relative_power_class = 7
	diplomacy_view_class = 7 
	can_send_tribute = no
	joins_overlords_wars = no
	joins_colonial_wars = yes	

	restoration_cb = cb_restore_cosmo_daimyo_personal_union_I

	can_fight = {
		other_overlord = all
		independent_nations = yes
		same_overlord = cosmo_daimyo_personal_union_I
		same_overlord = all
		colonial_region_nations = yes
		neighboring_primitives = yes
		colonial_region_nations = yes
	}
	can_rival = {
		independent_nations = yes
		same_overlord = cosmo_daimyo_personal_union_I
		same_overlord = all
		other_overlord = all
		neighboring_primitives = yes
		colonial_region_nations = yes
		colonial_region_nations = yes
	}
	can_ally = {
		independent_nations = yes
		same_overlord = cosmo_daimyo_personal_union_I
		same_overlord = all
		other_overlord = all
		neighboring_primitives = yes
		colonial_region_nations = yes
	}
	can_marry = {
		independent_nations = yes
		same_overlord = cosmo_daimyo_personal_union_I
		same_overlord = all
		other_overlord = all
		neighboring_primitives = yes
		colonial_region_nations = yes
	}

	# Subject Interactions:
	divert_trade = no	
	scutage = no
	subsidize_armies = yes
    enforce_religion = no
    grant_core_claim = yes
	support_loyalists = yes	
    takeondebt = yes
    bestow_gifts = yes
    send_additional_troops = yes
    fortify_march = yes
    increase_tariffs = no
    decrease_tariffs = no
	send_officers = yes
	press_sailors = no
	contribute_to_capital = no
	knowledge_sharing = yes	
	return_land = yes
	conscript_general = no	
	block_settlement_growth = yes
	allow_settlement_growth = yes	

	
	# Modifiers:
	modifier_overlord = clear 
	modifier_subject = clear 

	modifier_overlord = {
		modifier = daimyo_subject
	}
    overlord_opinion_modifier = in_union
    subject_opinion_modifier = in_union	
}
